components.css: .ds-btn-submit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: hsl(250 85% 65%); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-submit:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: scale(1.04); }
components.description: 44px violet square; the only full-accent control on screen.
components.name: Submit Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8a8a9a; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #e8e8ed; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
components.description: Quiet glass action for new game and hint.
components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.25rem 1rem; color: #e8e8ed; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus-within { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); box-shadow: 0 0 30px hsl(250 85% 65% / 0.08); }
components.description: Translucent guess field; glow appears only on focus.
components.name: Guess Input

components.css: .ds-guess-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 0.75rem; } .ds-guess-row .bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(140 70% 45%); box-shadow: 0 0 8px hsl(140 70% 45% / 0.3); }
components.description: Rank + word + temperature bar; the signature feedback unit.
components.name: Guess Row

components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 0.75rem; } .ds-stat span:first-child { font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #55556a; }
components.description: Small glass metric tile under the input.
components.name: Stat Card

shadows.purpose: Input focus ring companion and latest-guess halo.

label.purpose: Uppercase stat labels and rank denominators.

dos: Do keep the page near-black and let violet + score colors carry all meaning.
Do use glow only for focus, latest guess, score bars, and wins.
Do keep Inter everywhere; numerals tabular where ranks align.
donts: Don't add a light theme, a second accent hue, or serif/italic display type.
Don't put color on idle chrome.
Don't add accounts, nav bars, or multi-screen flows.
Don't invent testimonials, scores, or press.
narrative.overview: Konteksto is a dark, quiet room where a learner sits alone with Lithuanian words late at night. Color is never decoration — it only ever means progress. Feedback arrives fast but gently: soft transitions, celebration only on wins.

rules.body: Accent color and glow appear only as feedback — focus, latest guess, score bars, win state.
rules.name: The Glow-Means-Progress Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Glow appears only as a response to state.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
